caption: The drawing features a symmetrical, two-handled bowl rendered in shades of gray pencil on a plain, cream-colored background. The main object, centrally positioned and occupying most of the space, is an ornate, rounded bowl with a wide opening and gently undulating surface details. Along its exterior, the bowl has raised, curving vertical ridges that create framed sections, each containing subtle decorative flourishes near the base. The handles, one on each side, are large, circular, and extend outward before looping back to connect to the bowl, with a small decorative curl at their lower attachment points. The bowl sits on a short, circular base, which appears slightly flared. In the lower left corner of the drawing, there is an inset showing a simplified cross-sectional outline of the bowl from the side, including the same curving sections and a central dividing line. The entire composition is enclosed within a fine rectangular border, and there is a handwritten signature in the bottom right corner.
title: Silver Bowl
